message: Hi, I'm a student with a python certification background. My overall academic average is 79.2% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and cloud computing. I want to become a Technical Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 9600 per year. I live in Delhi. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program is located in Delhi, meeting your strong preference to stay near home. The tuition cost ($2100) is well within your family's budget of $9600, and while the median salary is modest, the location advantage makes it a top consideration.

This MSc Cloud Computing program is also in Delhi, satisfying your location preference. The low tuition cost ($950) makes it very budget-friendly, and the focus on cloud computing directly matches one of your primary interests.
